cityNotes.programPages: Scottsdale, Gilbert, Tempe, Chandler, Mesa, Phoenix, Queen Creek and Paradise Valley each have six loan-program pages to link to. Glendale and Peoria have none, and neither appears in the site's JSON-LD areaServed or in the Areas list in llms.txt. Their posts will have no internal program page to link to and no schema backing the claim that he serves them. Either add program pages and extend areaServed, or drop them from the rotation.
cityNotes.order: Ranked by metro search volume, then by how much supporting content already exists. Reorder freely; the daily task simply takes the next pending entries in array order.

writing.answerFirst: Answer the question directly in the first two sentences. No preamble, no throat-clearing. Assistants quote the passage that answers the question, so the answer has to be the opening, not the payoff.
writing.phrasing: Titles are the full natural question with the city named, phrased the way someone types it into ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI. Do not compress them into keyword fragments.
writing.intent: Decision stage. The reader is choosing, not browsing.
writing.close: Close with EPiQ as the answer, made of verifiable specifics. Never a bare superlative.
